name: opencode CLI (RHEL)
description: Installs the opencode CLI from npm.

agentVersion.description: opencode-ai version to install. Leave empty to resolve the newest published npm version at install time and pin that exact version; it does not float on later rebuilds of the same layer.

plugins.description: Space-separated list of opencode plugins (npm packages, optionally @version) to install on container creation, e.g. 'opencode-gitlab-auth'. Best-effort: a plugin that cannot be installed is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to install none.
